facts.fact: The Central Bank of Somalia says over two-thirds of payments in Somalia are already processed through mobile money and other digital platforms.
The Central Bank of Somalia says SIPS, launched January 2025, enables real-time 24/7 transfers between banks, mobile wallets and point-of-sale terminals regardless of provider.
The Central Bank of Somalia says the Somali Payment Switch and SIPS, launched January 2025, connect banks, mobile wallets and point-of-sale terminals in real time.
